label: Result First, Then Rewind
line: Open on the end state, ask what happened, name the culprit or the choice early, and prove it with pairs of numbers.
best_for: the rise or the fall of a product, a company or a technology
one decision that made or lost a fortune
also_for: the origin of a familiar product, when the origin is a surprise
avoid_for: a history with no single culprit or choice
a story with no figures to set side by side
a decline still unfolding this week: the end state is not settled
signals: the end state is known and striking
one culprit or one choice explains it
dated facts and a proof number exist
a before and an after can be set side by side

beats.name: End state
beats.job: The striking result first: the fall as a number, or the two extremes of one life.

beats.name: What happened
beats.job: The question, then the culprit or the choice, named.

beats.name: Rewind
beats.job: Two or three dated facts, in order.

beats.name: Proof number
beats.job: One figure against a benchmark the viewer knows.

beats.name: Consequence pair
beats.job: From A to B: the before and the after as numbers.

beats.name: Verdict
beats.job: One line that judges the choice.

hooks.shape: Remember [product]? [What it was]. [Its key figure] is down [N percent].
[Person] was [one extreme] in [year] and [the other extreme] by [year].
How does [a company that had everything] end up [end state]?
[Familiar product] exists because of [one surprising fact].

holds: The viewer knows how it ends and stays for the cause. Naming the culprit early turns the middle into evidence, and every fact carries a date or a number.
ending: The before-and-after pair, or one line that judges the choice. No lesson.
pitfalls: Telling it in date order from the beginning
No named person, choice or culprit
Figures with nothing to compare them to
An invented figure: every number has a source
template: Remember [X]? [What it meant]. [Its figure] is down [N percent]. So what happened? [One culprit or one choice]. In [year], [fact]. In [year], [fact]. [Proof number], more than [benchmark]. That turned [A] into [B] in [time]. [Verdict].
